title: ACKS II — Importer
description: Imports ACKS II book content into Foundry from the reader's own PDFs: monsters, proficiencies and class powers, equipment and price tables, adventure locations and roll tables. Ships extraction recipes — page geometry and patterns — and never the book text itself. Bring your own book.

requires.reason: Everything imported here lands in structures acks-extras owns: the rules-table registry it feeds through the `ruledata-import` service, the acks-extras.animal and acks-extras.template actor sub-types, the ability effect model, and the Full Monster Sheet stat block. Import writes into the acks-extras flag namespace so the imported world keeps working with this module uninstalled.

recommends.reason: Niche ability icons for the ACKS-shaped corners of the corpus (Acrobatics, Blind Fighting, Caving, Mapping). Optional: without it every ability falls back to a core Foundry icon.
